import httpx
from api_fetch import fetch_json


def open_ticket_titles(client: httpx.Client, project: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return all titles of open tickets for the given project, following pagination."""
    titles = []
    params = {"status": "open", "project": project}
    url = "/tickets"
    while url is not None:
        data = fetch_json(client, url, params=params)
        titles.extend(item["title"] for item in data["items"])
        url = data.get("next")
    return titles

from pkg_info import installed_version


def dependency_report(names: list[str]) -> dict[str, str | None]:
    """Return a dict mapping each given distribution name to its installed version string or None if not installed.

    The keys are exactly as given in `names`.
    Matching is case-insensitive.
    """
    result = {}
    for name in names:
        version = installed_version(name)
        result[name] = version
    return result
